guide.dudunka.intro.title: Start a family adventure
guide.dudunka.intro.body: Dudunka, Marusya and Syusya hatch from rare eggs. Search suitable structure chests; Syusya eggs also occur in nature. Arrows turn pages and the mouse wheel scrolls. My family shows nearby companions and their commands. A lost album can be crafted again: book + paper + ink sac.
guide.dudunka.dudunka.title: Finding Dudunka
guide.dudunka.dudunka.body: Search house chests in plains, taiga, snowy, savanna and desert villages. Eggs are rare extra finds. Profession chests, such as blacksmith chests, are not included.
guide.dudunka.dudunka.mvs: MVS also offers eggs in common and desert houses and flower structures with loot.
guide.dudunka.marusya.title: Finding Marusya
guide.dudunka.marusya.body: Search abandoned mineshaft and woodland mansion chests. Prepare for the dangers of these places.
guide.dudunka.marusya.mvs: In MVS, check the Tall House: its abandoned-loot containers can contain an egg.
guide.dudunka.marusya.dungeons: In YUNG’s Better Dungeons, search common chests in skeleton and zombie dungeons.
guide.dudunka.syusya.title: Finding Syusya
guide.dudunka.syusya.body: Eggs can appear in ordinary monster-room chests.
guide.dudunka.syusya.mvs: In MVS, search swamp house chests.
guide.dudunka.syusya.dungeons: In YUNG’s Better Dungeons, search loot containers in small dungeons.
guide.dudunka.syusya.natural: In nature, look on grass or moss near water in swamps, mangrove swamps and lush caves. Natural eggs are placed blocks and appear only in newly generated chunks.
guide.dudunka.syusya.bop: Biomes O’ Plenty adds Bayou, Marsh and Wetland. Grass or moss, nearby water and free space are still required.
guide.dudunka.old_world.title: Playing an existing world
guide.dudunka.old_world.body: A new world is not required. An existing structure container can receive an egg if its loot has not yet been generated; ordinary chests usually generate it on first opening. Opened chests do not refill. Some mods generate loot early or separately for each player. Natural eggs require previously ungenerated chunks; existing terrain is not updated.
guide.dudunka.care.title: Helping an egg hatch
guide.dudunka.care.body: Place the egg and right-click with treats. Dudunka needs bread, apple and cookie, with a bed and light nearby. Marusya needs cod or salmon, nearby wool or carpet, and light level at most 7. Syusya needs leaves and a mushroom, grass or moss below, and nearby water. The first suitable offering claims ownership. Right-click shows readiness and time; missing conditions pause hatching.
guide.dudunka.rare: Eggs are not guaranteed. Reopening a chest whose loot was already generated does not provide another roll.
guide.dudunka.loot_disabled: Egg chest loot is disabled in this server’s settings.
guide.dudunka.natural_disabled: Natural egg generation is disabled in this server’s settings.

trail.dudunka.title: A Little Traveller’s Trail — %s/4
trail.dudunka.note_tooltip: Right-click to record in your album. You can share it with a friend.
trail.dudunka.read: Note saved. Open Egg Search in your Family Album; the story follows the guide.
trail.dudunka.already_read: This note is already in your album.
trail.dudunka.saved_ahead: Note saved for later. Find the earlier pages to read the story in order.
trail.dudunka.locked: This page is still locked. Find and read the next note; its location is hinted on the previous page.
trail.dudunka.no_guarantee: The egg remains rare. Notes help you search but do not guarantee it. An egg found early can be hatched immediately.
trail.dudunka.disabled: Notes are disabled by the server. Normal egg searching is still available.
trail.dudunka.step.0: She loved big adventures and little houses. Sometimes she left a trail of cookie crumbs…
trail.dudunka.step.1: “I saw a black cat today. She said the cosiest houses are easy to spot by their flowers.”
trail.dudunka.step.2: “A house can be above ground or beneath it. What matters is that something blooms nearby.”
trail.dudunka.step.3: “If you find my little egg, bring bread, an apple and a cookie. Leave a bed and a light nearby — I am a little afraid of the dark.”
trail.dudunka.hint.0.mvs: Look for the first note in ungenerated loot in ordinary village houses. Right-click to read it.
trail.dudunka.hint.0.vanilla: Look for the first note in ungenerated loot in ordinary village houses. Right-click to read it.
trail.dudunka.hint.1.mvs: The next note can appear in common loot in MVS residential buildings. Not every chest uses that table.
trail.dudunka.hint.1.vanilla: Without MVS, further notes can be found in other village-house chests whose loot has not yet generated.
trail.dudunka.hint.2.mvs: Look for flower loot in MVS Flower Hole and certain Deepslate House chests. They can contain the last note and the rare egg.
trail.dudunka.hint.2.vanilla: Without MVS, the final note and rare egg can appear in ordinary village-house chests. Explore more houses.
trail.dudunka.hint.3.mvs: Place the egg near a bed and light, then offer bread, an apple and a cookie. With valid conditions it hatches after five loaded minutes at default settings.
trail.dudunka.hint.3.vanilla: Place the egg near a bed and light, then offer bread, an apple and a cookie. With valid conditions it hatches after five loaded minutes at default settings.

story.dudunka.marusya.title: The cat who chose a home · %s / 4
story.dudunka.syusya.title: Little Syusya's great journey · %s / 4
story.dudunka.marusya.step.0: A black hair and a paw print remained on an old windowsill. Someone was clearly looking for the coziest home. Village chests may still hold notes about her.
story.dudunka.marusya.step.1: “I met a large black cat with yellow eyes. She inspected the house, sniffed the cushion and sat on my paper. I think the introduction went well.”
story.dudunka.marusya.step.2: “Marusya tested the scratching post. Then she stretched as diligently as if she were on duty. I drew her portrait — she sat on it again. Is that approval?”
story.dudunka.marusya.step.3: “That evening Marusya rested her chin on her paws and began to purr. I thought I had found a cat. It seems the cat had found herself a family.”
story.dudunka.syusya.step.0: A tiny note rests on a leaf: “Off to see the world. No rush to get far.” Village chests may hold the other pages of Syusya's journey.
story.dudunka.syusya.step.1: “Syusya set out from the moss to the big leaf. I offered her a lift, but she raised her feelers: important journeys are best made on your own.”
story.dudunka.syusya.step.2: “It began to drizzle. Syusya tucked in her feelers and hid. Then she peeked out: dry ground on the left, a leaf on the right. She decided to check the leaf first. A sensible route.”
story.dudunka.syusya.step.3: “Syusya reached her little house. Marusya waited nearby while I drew her shell. The journey was small, but we welcomed her like a true traveler.”
story.dudunka.marusya.places: All three notes can appear in ungenerated loot in ordinary village house chests, abandoned mineshafts and woodland mansions. Right-click to read a note.
story.dudunka.marusya.mvs: With MVS, notes can appear in abandoned loot, for example in Tall House.
story.dudunka.marusya.dungeons: With Better Dungeons, notes can appear in common loot in skeleton and zombie dungeons.
story.dudunka.syusya.places: All three notes can appear in ungenerated loot in ordinary village house chests and vanilla dungeon chests. Right-click to read a note.
story.dudunka.syusya.mvs: With MVS, notes can appear in swamp house loot.
story.dudunka.syusya.dungeons: With Better Dungeons, notes can appear in small dungeon loot piles.
screen.dudunka.help.page.0:
1. Find an egg!

Syusya: dungeon chests; her eggs can also appear in new swamps and lush caves.
Marusya: mineshafts and woodland mansions.
Dudunka: village house chests. Her egg is the rarest!

No egg yet? Keep exploring!
screen.dudunka.help.page.1:
2. Help it hatch

Place the egg. Hold a treat and right-click it.

Syusya: leaves block + mushroom; grass or moss below, water nearby.
Marusya: raw cod or salmon; wool or carpet nearby, a dark spot.
Dudunka: bread + apple + cookie; a bed and torch nearby.

Keep everything within two blocks. Click the egg again to see what is missing. Usually it takes five minutes nearby. Do not break a growing egg!
screen.dudunka.help.page.2:
3. Care and explore

Right-click with a treat; wait 30 seconds between treats.
Dudunka loves bread, apples and cookies. Marusya loves raw fish. Syusya loves leaves, mushrooms and apples.

Usually a baby needs 20 loaded minutes to become a teen, then 20 more to become an adult. Feeding helps. World settings can change these times.

Shift + right-click with an empty hand: wait or walk together again. Wait for Syusya — she is slow!

Stop for three seconds near a small flower: your friends may look at it together. Walk on to continue your outing.
screen.dudunka.help.page.3:
4. Make a cozy home

Under a roof, place a regular bed, chest or barrel, torch and cake. Add the friend’s home marker: Dudunka’s Bed, Marusya’s Cushion or Syusya’s House. Keep everything within four blocks of the marker.

Right-click the marker with your friend nearby. Its message tells you what is missing.

Add a drawing table, scratching bed or snail hut with a leaf. Leave the entrance clear!
Album → My family → choose a friend → Assign furniture → At home.

Place the friends’ home markers nearby and choose At home for everyone. When Dudunka shows a drawing, Marusya rests or Syusya peeks out, a free friend may come to watch. Leave clear floor in front of the furniture and stay nearby!

Add a glass window in an outside wall and a planted flower pot. During rain, friends may watch the window, rest together and inspect the pot.

Walk away from home for at least 10 seconds and come back: friends may greet you! The home must remain loaded. Close friends can settle together.
screen.dudunka.help.page.4:
5. Read and find stories

You get an album on your first join. Lost it? Craft another from a book, paper and an ink sac.

The egg guide has clues. My family shows your friends, Follow and Wait here. If your own friend is missing, try Recovery.

Found a note? Hold it and right-click. A story page is saved in your album, even when found out of order.

Explore, care and bring your little family together!

Album → choose a friend → Requests. Come closer, accept a request and press Help when ready. Skip without penalties. Right-click the keepsake to open it; the album retains your memory.

Memories keeps first milestones and captions from your friends. All family shows home, follow, wait and carrier states. A friend out of sight has last known information.
request.dudunka.commands: Accept a request, help, or skip it.
request.dudunka.scope: Nearby friends' requests. Come within 8 blocks of your friend.
request.dudunka.offer: A small kind deed is available. Press Accept first.
request.dudunka.active: Accepted. Your friend will wait as long as you need.
request.dudunka.cooldown: Another request in %s seconds of game time. Reopen the album to refresh.
request.dudunka.how.flower: Find one ordinary small flower, such as an oxeye daisy or dandelion. Come to Dudunka and press Help to give one from your inventory.
request.dudunka.how.cozy: Prepare a personal home: roof, bed, chest, light and cake. Assign matching furniture through the album. Come to your friend and press Help. An existing ready home counts too.
request.dudunka.how.treat: Right-click your friend with a favourite food, or press Help nearby to give one portion from your inventory. A full friend may need up to 30 seconds.
request.dudunka.optional: No deadlines, daily chores or penalties. Helping earns a keepsake, a memory here and a little trust. Helping or skipping starts a 10-minute game-time break before the next request.
request.dudunka.description.dudunka.flow: Dudunka: "Could you bring a small flower? I want to draw it before Marusya decides to sleep on it!"
request.dudunka.description.dudunka.trea: Dudunka: "A snack after our walk? An apple, bread or a cookie would be lovely!"
request.dudunka.description.marusya.cozy: Marusya: "Purr. Very important resting needs a cosy home and my own cat bed."
request.dudunka.description.marusya.trea: Marusya: "Resting calls for fish. Cod or salmon will do nicely."
request.dudunka.description.syusya.treat: Syusya: "I made it! An apple, mushroom or leaf, please? That was three whole steps."
request.dudunka.thanks.dudunka: Dudunka thanks you and gives you a keepsake drawing!
request.dudunka.thanks.marusya: Marusya purrs. You received a note about your kind deed!
request.dudunka.thanks.syusya: Syusya wiggles her feelers. You received a little note!
keepsake.dudunka.tooltip: Right-click to read. You can share it with another player.
screen.dudunka.result.request_accepted: Request accepted. Help whenever you like.
screen.dudunka.result.request_completed: Thank you! You received a keepsake and a memory.
screen.dudunka.result.request_not_ready: Not ready yet. Come closer and check items or home conditions. A full friend may need up to 30 seconds.
keepsake.dudunka.dudunka.flower: The drawing shows a flower with enormous glasses. "Now it is family too!"
keepsake.dudunka.dudunka.treat: Dudunka drew a picnic: the crumbs are bigger than Syusya. "We are just very small."
keepsake.dudunka.marusya.cozy: Marusya inspected every side of her bed. Verdict: "Purr. Approved for long naps."
keepsake.dudunka.marusya.treat: The fish disappeared. Marusya looks as though this is an important scientific discovery.
keepsake.dudunka.syusya.treat: Syusya: "Thanks for the treat! I wrote this slowly, but with all my shell."
memory.dudunka.note: First milestones for each kind of friend stay here. Days count from the start of the world. Real events create new entries.
memory.dudunka.empty: No entries yet. Our story is still ahead!

memory.dudunka.dudunka.hatched: I peeked out of my egg. Where’s my backpack?
memory.dudunka.dudunka.teen: I grew! Reaching the flowers is easier now.
memory.dudunka.dudunka.adult: I’m grown up now. I’ll still draw funny pictures!
memory.dudunka.dudunka.met_marusya: I met Marusya. What a huge fluffy friend!
memory.dudunka.dudunka.met_syusya: I met Syusya. I’ll take slower steps.
memory.dudunka.dudunka.shared_scene: I settled beside my friends. It’s cozier together.
memory.dudunka.marusya.hatched: I hatched. First, I’ll check for soft spots.
memory.dudunka.marusya.teen: I got longer. Tail, please keep up.
memory.dudunka.marusya.adult: I grew up. My fluffy collar needs a big pillow.
memory.dudunka.marusya.met_dudunka: I met Dudunka. She’s small, but very interesting.
memory.dudunka.marusya.met_syusya: I met Syusya. At last, someone who doesn’t rush.
memory.dudunka.marusya.shared_scene: I settled beside my friends. Purr. Good company.
memory.dudunka.syusya.hatched: I came out of my egg. The big world can wait while I look around.
memory.dudunka.syusya.teen: I grew. So did my shell. My speed stayed the same.
memory.dudunka.syusya.adult: I’m grown up. I still choose little steps.
memory.dudunka.syusya.met_dudunka: I met Dudunka. She knows how to wait for me.
memory.dudunka.syusya.met_marusya: I met Marusya. So much soft shade!
memory.dudunka.syusya.shared_scene: I finally reached my friends. My spot waited for me.
